forget.body: {count, plural, one {This will be removed from this computer for good, along with anything Nocturne worked out from it.} other {These will be removed from this computer for good, along with anything Nocturne worked out from them.}}

forget.original.blocked: Other memories still use this, so it stays.

forget.nothing: There is nothing left to forget here.

forget.done.originalGone: {count, plural, one {The original is} other {# originals are}} deleted too.
forget.done.tail: They won’t appear in answers, pages or anywhere else.
